evidence.summary: Residual accepted by D-0056: an admin account now sees and edits every product line, so admin is the sensitive role; compromise of one admin session exposes all product data and admin role assignment is the control (UI note shows it when an admin is selected). Stub-mode forged numeric X-User-Id with X-User-Role admin gets '*' (local/pytest only). Fail-closed residual: the scope is transaction-local, so a read after commit in the same request sees no lines (measured on cip_test: after commit current_setting returns '').

rationale: Threats enumerated with their controls; the admin residual is the accepted rule, not a defect; post-commit behaviour fails closed and is an open item.
